rows.TEXT: Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in her times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended her reign of terror. She is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to her will.

Queen Yataa'Halli 
"Dwarven friends! It pleases me to address you on this day, though the nights will be long for some time. The Great Wyrm Nhiddog tested our might, and was bested. The great mountains shook, but they are now still..."

Queen Yataa'Halli 
"I proclaim that this day be remembered by all! A day of triumph, and a day of sacrifice. Messengers have been sent to inform all of our kin that the danger has passed - The Wyrm has fallen! Nevendaar is safe once more!"

Loremaster Flinthide 
"Wotan has delivered peace to us! His valkyries battled in the heavens and silenced the very forces that demolished our realm!"

Loremaster Flinthide 
"The twelve elder Loremasters must gather to chronicle what we have witnessed. Surely this is one of the greatest spectacles of our history! Generations of Dwarves shall marvel and weep at the tales of the Ragnarok!"

Loremaster Flinthide  
"We must make haste to Fort Ironhill and seek Loremaster Ironhill within, for he is chief among our order. The path lies south!"

Venerable Warrior 
"Ready yourselves Dwarves, beasts approach!"

Virimos 
"Ahhhh...Dwarves! You are only half as filling as real people...I hope there are enough of you out there make it worth my while."

Wolf 
"Worry not, devout followersss, Wotan protects you."

King's Guard 
"I have seen it with my own eyes! The spirits of Wotan walk among us! I am not worthy of such an honor! Why have you come to us, great wolves?"

Wolf 
"Our God sendsss usss to you with a messsage... Take thisss, friend! Read it well! Everything hasss been decided, Wotan will appear to hisss people if you follow the dictatesss of thisss text."

Loremaster 
"The scroll speaks of a ritual! I must reveal these events to my fellow Loremasters..."

Dwarf 
"There it is - Fort Ironhill! I was sure its foundations could withstand the quaking earth of the Ragnarok."

Runemaster 
"Guard! It is safe to raise the Gate. The Demon has been killed!"

Orfol Ironhill 
"Thank you fellows! We have not left our stronghold for days! This volcano seems a gateway to Bethrezen's realm! We bested the lesser demons that issued forth from the lava, but the gargoyle was too strong for our dwindling forces."

Venerable Warrior 
"The gateway must be sealed! Loremaster Ironhill once sealed Bethrezen in a mountain prison with a runic seal... Loremaster Ironhill has the knowledge!"

Orfil Ironhill 
"Loremaster Ironhill has died. The injuries he suffered during the earthquakes took his life!"

Venerable Warrior 
"We are truly sorry for your loss! He was a great Dwarf, and an important scholar. We will fetch Loremaster Sevendusk to do the task in his stead. The Demons shall be sealed away."

Loremaster Flinthide
"I suppose we will have to find successors for Loremaster Thunderhammer, Loremaster Darkstone and Loremaster Ironhill - but who?"

Warrior 
"Wotan wishes to speak to us!"

Archdruidess 
"Yes. The last time such a blessing was attempted was long before the First Great Wars..."

Archdruidess 
"The idea caused great controversy. For the Loremasters to call upon their god was against the original precepts of the order."

Warrior 
"And what was Wotan's message that day?"

Archdruidess 
"The rite did not take place! It was impossible without all of the Loremasters present to complete the sacred circle. And then the Great Wars came, nonetheless..."

Crossbowman 
"The quakes were hard on this city, indeed. The walls still crumble before our slightest touch."

Novice 
"The Greenskins could not grasp the importance of this scroll. Lucky indeed for us!"

Dwarf Champion 
"Do not venture too far south, for the grey scourge of the Undead is again upon us. Mortis' minions tread far too close to our borders!"

Dwarf 
"Heed us! There are strange creatures waiting ahead! The webs of Giant spiders stretch across mountain ranges."

Novice 
"And horrible dragons breathe death upon the lands, killing everything!"

Novice  
"Thank you for your Dwarven hospitality, Clan Sevendusk!"

Inquisitor 
"Who dares to oppose the destiny of this realm? Crowley will rule all of the virtuous. All unclean ones shall perish!"

Acolyte 
"Count Crowley will prevail, for it has been foreseen. The Inquisition will cleanse the Empire and then the Dwarves will be dealt with."

Barbarian 
"Hah! Our brothers in Allengarbe will be warned about you and your kind..."

Novice 
"To the south lie the Undead. To the east lie the Legions. Thank the Elders that our path lies between these two dangers!"

Druidess 
"The Loremaster order is anxiously awaiting Loremaster Ironhill. We were charged with finding him, and find him we must!"

Titan 
"There are more and more of these dragons appearing each day. Have they not reached your lands?"

Novice 
"No, we have not yet encountered them within our own territories... from whence have they come?"

Titan 
"We always see them first silhouetted against the southern sky. We are searching for their lairs, but they remain hidden..."

Novice 
"Thank you for the warning. We will keep careful watch, especially to the south. Good day!"

Venerable Warrior 
"Ah! So these are the Spider Den Mountains. My father told me tales of these ranges in my youth. There are spiders here which stand larger than any Dwarf!"

Titan 
"My scouts tell me that you have rid these lands of the beast! He often raided our villages for food. We've not much left to give you, but we thank you for your bravery!"

Titan 
"I see some of your men have been wounded. Please, at least accept this balm..."

Dwarf 
"This must be the Dragon's nest! Quickly, let's cover the pit with earth. We'll make sure no beast will ever dwell here again!"

Venerable Warrior 
"Wait! We should look inside first! I said stop digging, oaf!"

Dwarf 
"Wotan's beard! 'Tis a fine thing you stopped us. I'd always thought dragon's treasure was a tale for whelps!"

Deskin Cloudkeeper 
"Queen Yataa'Halli! I have news! A catastrophe, earthquakes, floods, fires..."

Queen Yataa'Halli 
"Fear not, gentle Deskin! The danger has passed... true, Ragnarok  gripped Nevendaar, but Wotan has preserved order in the heavens."

Queen Yataa'Halli 
"I have sent  men to your territory, to help rebuild if help is needed..."

Deskin Cloudkeeper 
"Thank you, Queen Yataa'Halli! When you were a princess of our clan, we knew that your wisdom would make you a fine ruler. You bring pride to your kin. All hail Queen Yataa'Halli of Clan Cloudkeeper!"
For Queen Yataa'Halli's brave people? I am honoured!

Gorvus Darkstone 
"I have come far... to report... to my Queen..."

Queen Yataa'Halli 
"Please! Tell me...how does Clan Darkstone fair after the war? "

Gorvus Darkstone 
"There are far too many injured. Avalanches came crashing down onto the rooftops of our city."

Gorvus Darkstone 
"In all of the confusion, Loremaster Darkstone was injured. He lingered in this world for a few days, and then passed away. Surely he sits at the feet of Wotan now."

Queen Yataa'Halli 
"May his soul find glory.  The death of an elder Loremaster is a tragic loss for our people. Fear not, we will send aid to your cities at once."
Wotan speed the Valiant Mountain Folk. The Wyrm has been defeated!

Ferroc Flinthide 
"Queen Yataa'Halli! What is going on in this world? Earthquakes decimated the western portion of our city."

Queen Yataa'Halli 
"Ragnarok, the war of the Gods, brought unnatural events into our world. When all seemed hopeless, great Wotan battled in his realm for our safety, and seized victory!"

Ferroc Flinthide 
"But Queen, evil yet stalks these lands! I have seen Mortis' fleshless armies in the south, they survived the Ragnarok as well!"

Queen Yataa'Halli 
"Yes, problems still remain in the mortal realm. Wotan cannot fight our battles for us! These are simply tests of our courage, we must endure any trial. I am confident Clan Flinthide will be legendary centuries from now!"
Come in, I will make worthy fighters out of your frail soldiers.

Maurus Fogfell 
"I come to you, Dwarven brothers..."

Loremaster Flinthide 
"Maurus, old friend! We have sent a messenger to your Clan! Times have been hard, but we hope that gathering our elders will help establish peace after Ragnarok."

Maurus Fogfell 
"How can we have peace when Ragnarok has not cleansed this world of evil?"

Maurus Fogfell 
"Nobles of the Empire are pushing our bounderies back. They do not recognize the treaties that our Queen and the late King Demosthene created... Have we no allies in this world?"

Loremaster Flinthide 
"The Humans are divided. Without their king, many struggle for the throne. Do not assume that those troubling you represent the will of the Empire. I assure you, we still have allies among them."

Chod Greyhelm 
"Your messengers came to us...do not fret, fair Queen, we are safe. Although it pains me to hear that other Clans did not fair the same."

Chod Greyhelm 
"A Dwarf came to us from Ironhill...there is certainly danger there, my Queen! The Dwarf was so frightened, he hasn't spoken a word!"

Princess Yataa'Halli 
"This is ill news indeed. I have sent a party to Ironhill only recently. I must warn them to take caution."
I have some powerful new spells that might interest you.

Queen Yataa'Halli 
"What news from Clan Thunderhammer?"

Tugli Thunderhammer 
"Oh woe! My Queen...death, desolation, and little hope."

Tugli Thunderhammer 
"Loremaster Thunderhammer is gone! We believe he was lost when an avalanche demolished our meeting hall."

Queen Yataa'Halli 
"Such tragedy!  Loremaster Thunderhammer was a wise Dwarf.  It takes years of experience to become a true Loremaster, and now we've lost two."

Loremaster Flinthide 
"We will try to find a solution. The remaining Loremasters mourn the loss of brothers Thunderhammer and Darkstone... We still have no news of Loremaster Ironhill or his Clan..."
What? Dwarves in Mortis' territory? I will conceal your presence here if I can...
Everything I possess is for sale.

Axe Thrower 
"These creatures seem to have no reason to attack us, yet they fight with an inexhaustible rage...such evil."

Archdruidess 
"As long as there is good there will be evil to oppose it. If we submit to it, then the Ragnarok will claim us all. This is why the Loremasters must carry the Word of Wotan from generation to generation."

Mountaineer 
"It is most unusual to find men living this far North."

Tenderfoot 
"They attacked us on first sight!"

Runemaster 
"The Empire has no single ruler. The demons killed their King, and now there are many factions craving the crown. Times are hard, and many have left their homes rather than endure the abuse of cruel lords."

Veteran 
"This chalice is stained with blood!"

Novice 
"These occultists long for communion with the unholy one. We could have become the next sacrifice to their Dark Lord!"

Dwarf 
"Aren't we passing through Mortis' territory? Wouldn't it  be wiser to avoid any further contact with those abominations?"

Runemaster 
"We will not change our route at every sign of danger. We are guided by Wotan!"

Runemaster 
"More Empire citizens forced to seek refuge. They trust no one. It's sad to see our old allies thus, and now they must see us as their foes."

Warrior 
"This is the most opulent ruin I have ever seen!

Hurden Cloverhorn 
"How fare you, Dwarves? The Ragnarok has not broken your spirits, I trust!"

Hurden Cloverhorn 
"Please permit us to provide for your comfort while you are in our territory. We urge you to rest your weary feet and avail yourselves of Cloverhorn's entertainments! The more devout may worship at Rigga's shrine."

Hurden Cloverhorn 
"The less devout may join us in Brewynna's Tavern for a round of Ale!"

Veteran 
"Thank you for your kindness, Clan Cloverhorn! We regret that we cannot stay. We're searching for Fort Ironhill. Our cartographer must never have left his keep! Perhaps you know the way?"

Hurden Cloverhorn 
"Ah! Fort Ironhill! To reach this place you must continue south, but return anytime you need our aid...or just a strong drink!"

Gurven Sevendusk 
"We're happy to see you, lads! It's been quite some time since we've heard from Queen Yataa'Halli."

Rune Master 
"How has Clan Sevendusk fared? Your city looks like it has been left untouched! Did you not see the storms or feel the rumbling beneath the surface?"

Gurven Sevendusk 
"We have been spared the worst of the Ragnarok. A few storms did assault us, but passed without harm. Clan Ironhill has not been so fortunate, I'm afraid..."

Rune Master 
"Clan Ironhill? We are on our way to aid them if needed."

Gurven Sevendusk 
"They certainly need it! Ironhill is a mite farther south. We spared all of the soldiers we could but none have returned!"

Archdruidess 
"This is a shrine dedicated to the ancient Dwarven warrior, Rigga!"

Archdruidess 
"A divine gift? Saint Rigga, we are honoured! Your battle with the Black Dragons shall inspire us to be as brave as you once were."

Runemaster 
"They are demons of Bethrezen's army! Look!"

Veteran 
"And beyond them is Fort Ironhill! Ironhill is under siege!"
